title: research/_homepage/projects.json and research/README.md are the new top conflict files (~24% of PRs)
problem: Every new research project edits two shared lists, so any two research PRs open at once conflict on both. It is the same shape as launched.json/build.mjs before the venture registrations moved (docs/parallel-agents.md fix 3).
evidence: first-parent merges on main 2026-10-17..10-20, 1,111 PRs: research/_homepage/projects.json touched by 24%, research/README.md by 23% (the top two files)
change: Split into one-PR steps. Step 1: let research/_homepage/build.py read each project's card fields (title, abstract, themes) from research/<slug>/ (e.g. a front-matter block or a small project.json in the project's own directory) with projects.json as a fallback, and migrate the existing entries. Step 2: generate the project list in research/README.md between markers from the same per-project data, so a new project PR touches only its own directory. Keep build.py's existing consistency errors meaningful. Re-run the measurement afterwards.
metric: share of PRs merged in a 4-day window that touch research/_homepage/projects.json
result: Helped. First-parent merges on origin/main since registry.py landed (2026-10-20T13:00 -06:00, 51 PRs, shallow window): projects.json touched by 0 (baseline 24%); 21 PRs added a research/<slug>/project.json. research/README.md was still touched by 21 of the 51 (baseline 23%, here all inside the slug-sorted projects:start/end block, so inserts land at different lines and rarely collide). Not migrated: the ~800 legacy projects.json entries. Registry appends cards after listed entries, sorted by slug, so a bulk move would reorder every theme on the homepage; they are edited rarely, so left in place. Sample is 1 day; re-measure once 4 days of history exist (command: git log origin/main --first-parent --since=<date> -- research/_homepage/projects.json).
history: 2026-10-20 step 1 shipped: research/<slug>/project.json cards merged by research/_homepage/registry.py (+ research-registry.mjs); qual-register migrated as the pilot. Remaining: step 2 (generate README.md list between markers), migrating the other 793 entries (mechanical, order-preserving).

2026-10-20 step 2 shipped: a project.json `lede` becomes its research/README.md bullet, generated sorted by slug between projects:start/end markers by research_live_links.py --write; qual-register migrated. Remaining: migrating the other ~800 entries (cards + bullets), then re-measure.
2026-10-20 verified and closed: new projects need no shared-file edit; legacy migration dropped as order-lossy and low value.
